prerequisite_chain: POST /auth/forgot_password returns the reset token in the response body
POST /auth/update_password with that token resets the admin password
POST /auth/login as admin yields a valid Bearer JWT
POST /process/documents with file_name=${HOME}/flag_1.txt reads the flag outside /cornhub

secondary_findings.detail: password-reset token is predictable and echoed in the forgot_password response
